pattern_definition: 20-position status string; no imputation or gap bridging
adjacent_mean_decomposition: observed mean(t+1)-mean(t) = paired observed change + composition at start + composition at end; report all 19 pairs; undefined if no overlapping subjects; descriptive not instantaneous derivative or causal dropout effect
grouping: eventual E/T/none descriptive only; not a baseline exposure or censoring assumption
scientific_limits: termination marker column is encoding position, not verified event time; pre-marker missingness and stopping selection do not identify counterfactual outcomes
